manifest.name: dsh-carryon
manifest.description: CarryOn context folding (arXiv:2610.18784) as a compaction plugin for DeepSeek Harness (experimental)
manifest.author: xuan-tu-ai

bundle.text:
# dsh-carryon bundle layer: run CarryOnCompactionEngine as `ctx.compaction`.
#
# Profiles without agent presets (headless, tui, sdk, acp) mount compaction at the root as row
# `compaction-basic`. A patch row cannot re-point an existing row to another plugin (its `name` must match), so
# we disable that row and insert our own. CarryOnCompactionEngine extends BasicCompactionEngine and takes the
# same config keys (thresholdRatio, retainTokens, ...); config written for `compaction-basic` must move to
# `carryon-compaction`.
#
# Profiles built on dsh-web-app (web, desktop) mount compaction inside each agent preset instead and disable
# the root row. There the root carryon row stays disabled (a root engine would also hear preset agents) and
# web-preset.patch.yml adds "CarryOn mode", which is made the default preset below.
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: carryon-compaction
      name: dsh-carryon
      disabled: !!js "ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app') === true"

# GENERATED by scripts/gen-web-preset.mjs from @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.2.2-alpha.3 presets/standard.patch.yml. Do not edit.
#
# "CarryOn mode": dsh's standard agent preset with dsh-carryon as its compaction backend. Only enabled in
# profiles built on dsh-web-app (web, desktop), where compaction lives inside agent presets.
- insert:
    - id: preset-carryon
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      disabled: !!js "!(ctx.get('profileContext')?.startedBundles?.includes('@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app') === true)"
      config:
        id: carryon
        name: CarryOn mode
        description: Standard mode with CarryOn context folding (dsh-carryon, experimental).
        order: 0
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              # Set false to drop the apply_patch tool beside edit.
              applyPatch: false
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: tool-schedule
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-schedule'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until the user approves your plan through exit_plan_mode or switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: carryon-compaction
                name: dsh-carryon
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: !!js "!ctx.get('profileContext')"
          - id: tool-plugin-market
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market/tools'
            disabled: true

# Make "CarryOn mode" the default agent preset for new sessions in profiles built on dsh-web-app.
# A user's own default choice in the Web UI (the registry's `selectedDefault`) still wins.
# Profiles without agent presets have no `agent-preset-registry` row, so dsh prints one
# "patch: entry not found" warning there; it is harmless.
- id: agent-preset-registry
  config:
    default: carryon

readme.text:
dsh-carryon

CarryOn context folding for DeepSeek Harness: long agent sessions keep what they established, not the whole transcript.
English · 简体中文

When a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) session grows long, dsh compacts it
by summarizing old turns into free text. dsh-carryon replaces that step with **CarryOn** from
[*Pack Light, CarryOn*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18784). Old turns are folded into small, versioned records of
what the agent has established ("carriers") and an execution context: the task, open obligations and the next step.
Each fold is validated before it is committed, and a rejected fold changes nothing.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f4a6889-5cf6-41a4-aff1-327a9d5d6b7b

CarryOn demo by the paper's authors. Also on the project page.
The CarryOn runtime, from the paper. In dsh-carryon, dsh decides when to fold and keeps the recent turns; the Grounder is not ported yet (details).

[Configuration](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) · [How it works](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md) · [Development](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [Benchmark](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/bench/README.md) · [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) · [Releasing](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/release.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

- **Drop-in backend.** dsh-carryon replaces dsh's compaction in the terminal, headless, SDK and ACP profiles. dsh
  keeps its trigger, its verbatim tail and its safety checks, and `/compact` works as before.
- **CarryOn mode in the Web UI.** The plugin adds a mode next to Standard mode, so you can compare both in the same
  app.
- **Validated folds.** A fold that fails validation leaves the session untouched. Rescans then back off as in the
  paper. Close to the context limit, a failed fold falls back to dsh's own summary, so the session can go on.
- **Resumable.** Fold state is stored as readable JSON in the session log and restored on resume.
- **Ported, not reinvented.** The runtime is a TypeScript port of [carrycode](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/carrycode),
  checked case by case against its parity fixtures.

```mermaid flowchart LR A["Session reaches
dsh's compaction threshold"] --> B["Tracker
updates candidates"] B -->|compile request| C["Compiler
carrier edits +
execution context"] B -->|nothing to compile| R

The checkpoint holds every carrier and the execution context. dsh keeps the most recent turns verbatim after it.
A fold costs one Tracker call, plus one Compiler call when the Tracker asks for compilation; dsh's own compaction
makes one summary call. The engine, the state format and how this port differs from the paper are described in
[How it works](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md).

These results come from the paper (Lu, McAuley, Zhang, 2026), with Claude Opus 4.7 as the agent. dsh-carryon has not
been benchmarked against them.
OSWorld 2.0. CarryOn improves both binary and partial scores of the same Claude Opus 4.7 agent while cutting cost per task by 35.9%. Figure from the paper's authors.
Context and cost over agent turns on OSWorld 2.0. The baseline's input context keeps growing past 200K tokens, while CarryOn's stays near 65K. Figure from the paper's authors.
On BrowseComp-Plus, the paper reports accuracy rising from 49.0% to 56.0% with 22.9% fewer tokens per task.

You need [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **0.2.2-alpha.3** (each dsh-carryon release supports
exactly one dsh release), Node.js 24.9 or later (dsh's own requirement), and pnpm on your `PATH`
(`npm install -g pnpm`), which `dsh plugin` calls.

Install the plugin into the profile you use. For the terminal UI:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui add dsh-carryon
```

For the Web UI:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile web add dsh-carryon
```

If dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3 is already installed globally, drop the `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3` prefix, for example
`dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-carryon`. The same goes for the commands below.

Restart dsh: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3` opens the terminal UI, and
`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 web` serves the Web UI and prints its address. In the terminal UI, every compaction is now a CarryOn fold. In the Web UI, new sessions start in
**CarryOn mode**, which you can switch from the mode menu next to the chat box:

`dsh plugin` passes its arguments to pnpm in the profile's directory, so pnpm's commands work. Check that the plugin
is installed:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui list
```

In the Web UI it is also listed under **Plugins → Installed plugins**. Once the session is long enough to compact
(or after `/compact`), a fold's checkpoint appears where dsh shows a compaction summary, and its full state is under
Trajectory → Raw Output.

Update to the latest release for your dsh version:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui update dsh-carryon
```

Remove it:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui remove dsh-carryon
```

Use `--profile web` for the Web UI. Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md).

The plugin's config row is `carryon-compaction`. It accepts dsh's own compaction keys (`thresholdRatio`,
`retainTokens`, …) and a few CarryOn keys. For example, put this in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/tui/cordis.patch.yml` to fold at
half of the context window and run the CarryOn roles on the cheaper `deepseek-flash`:

```yaml
- id: carryon-compaction
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.5
    runtimeProvider: deepseek-official

dsh replaces a row's whole `config` with the patched one, so list all your keys together. See
[Configuration](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) for every key, the defaults, and the Web UI's limits.

dsh-carryon implements the method of this paper. If you use it in research, please cite the paper:

```bibtex
@misc{lu2026carryon,
  title         = {Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents},
  author        = {Lu, Yuchen and McAuley, Julian and Zhang, Lei},
  year          = {2026},

carrycode and dsh-carryon are independent reimplementations built from the paper. They are not affiliated with the
paper's authors or with DeepSeek.

dsh-carryon's code is [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/LICENSE). The demo video and the figures shown above belong to the paper's authors,
who gave permission to show them here; they are not covered by that license.

dsh-carryon

为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 CarryOn 上下文折叠：长会话保留已确立的进展，而不是整段历史。

English · 简体中文

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）的会话变长时，dsh 会把较早的轮次总结成一段自由文本来压缩上下文。dsh-carryon 用论文 [*Pack Light, CarryOn*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.18784) 中的 **CarryOn** 替换这一步：较早的轮次被折叠（fold）成两部分。一部分是记录智能体已确立内容的小型、带版本的记录，称为“载体”（carrier）。另一部分是执行上下文，包含任务、未完成的义务和下一步。每次折叠在提交前都会经过校验，被拒绝的折叠不会改变任何东西。

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f4a6889-5cf6-41a4-aff1-327a9d5d6b7b

论文作者制作的 CarryOn 演示视频，也可在项目主页观看。
论文中的 CarryOn 运行时示意图。在 dsh-carryon 中，何时折叠以及保留哪些最近轮次由 dsh 决定；Grounder 尚未移植（详情，英文）。

[配置](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/configuration.md) · [工作原理](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md) · [开发](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/development.md) · [基准测试](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/bench/README.md) · [故障排除](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md) · [发布](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/release.md) · [更新日志](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
以上文档为英文。

- **直接替换。** 在终端、headless、SDK 和 ACP 配置中，dsh-carryon 替换 dsh 的压缩后端。触发条件、原样保留的尾部和安全检查仍由 dsh 负责，`/compact` 照常可用。
- **Web UI 中的 CarryOn mode。** 插件在 Standard mode 旁边新增一个模式，可以在同一个应用里对比两者。
- **折叠经过校验。** 未通过校验的折叠不会改动会话，之后的扫描按论文的方式退避。接近上下文上限时，失败的折叠会退回到 dsh 自己的总结，会话得以继续。
- **可恢复。** 折叠状态以可读的 JSON 保存在会话日志中，恢复会话时会重建。
- **移植而非重写。** 运行时是 [carrycode](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/carrycode) 的 TypeScript 移植，逐条对照其一致性测试用例（parity fixtures）检查。

```mermaid flowchart LR A["会话达到
dsh 的压缩阈值"] --> B["Tracker
更新候选"] B -->|请求编译| C["Compiler
载体修改 +
执行上下文"] B -->|无需编译| R 检查点包含所有载体和执行上下文，dsh 会在它之后原样保留最近的轮次。每次折叠调用一次 Tracker；Tracker 请求编译时，再调用一次 Compiler。dsh 自带的压缩只调用一次总结。引擎、状态格式以及本移植与论文的差异，见[工作原理](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md)。

以下结果来自论文（Lu、McAuley、Zhang，2026），智能体使用 Claude Opus 4.7。dsh-carryon 尚未对照这些结果做过基准测试。

OSWorld 2.0。CarryOn 提高了同一个 Claude Opus 4.7 智能体的二值得分和部分得分，同时把每个任务的成本降低 35.9%。图片来自论文作者。

OSWorld 2.0 上上下文与成本随智能体轮次的变化。基线的输入上下文持续增长到 200K token 以上，而 CarryOn 稳定在约 65K。图片来自论文作者。

在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，论文报告准确率从 49.0% 提升到 56.0%，每个任务的 token 减少 22.9%。

需要 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **0.2.2-alpha.3**（每个 dsh-carryon 版本只支持一个 dsh 版本）、Node.js 24.9 或更高版本（dsh 自身的要求），以及 `PATH` 中可用的 pnpm（`npm install -g pnpm`），`dsh plugin` 会调用它。

把插件安装到你使用的配置（profile）中。终端界面：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui add dsh-carryon
```

Web UI：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile web add dsh-carryon
```

如果已全局安装 dsh 0.2.2-alpha.3，可以省略 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3` 前缀，例如
`dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-carryon`。下面的命令同样如此。

重启 dsh：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3` 打开终端界面，`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 web` 启动 Web UI 并打印其地址。在终端界面中，每次压缩都会变成一次 CarryOn 折叠。在 Web UI 中，新会话默认使用 **CarryOn mode**，可以在输入框旁的模式菜单中切换：

`dsh plugin` 会把参数转交给配置目录中的 pnpm，所以 pnpm 的命令都可以使用。检查插件是否已安装：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui list
```

在 Web UI 中，插件也会出现在 **Plugins → Installed plugins** 中。会话长到触发压缩（或执行 `/compact`）后，折叠的检查点显示在 dsh 显示压缩总结的位置，完整状态在 Trajectory → Raw Output 中。

更新到适用于你的 dsh 版本的最新发布：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui update dsh-carryon
```

卸载：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-alpha.3 plugin --profile tui remove dsh-carryon
```
Web UI 请使用 `--profile web`。遇到问题？见[故障排除](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md)（英文）。

插件的配置行是 `carryon-compaction`。它接受 dsh 自带压缩的键（`thresholdRatio`、`retainTokens` 等），以及少量 CarryOn 专用的键。例如，下面的配置写入 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/tui/cordis.patch.yml` 后，会在上下文窗口用到一半时折叠，并让 CarryOn 的角色调用使用更便宜的 `deepseek-flash`：

```yaml
- id: carryon-compaction
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.5
    runtimeProvider: deepseek-official

dsh 会用补丁中的 `config` 整体替换该行的配置，所以请把所有要改的键写在一起。全部键、默认值以及 Web UI 中的限制见[配置](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/docs/configuration.md)。

dsh-carryon 实现的是这篇论文的方法。如果你在研究中使用它，请引用该论文：

```bibtex
@misc{lu2026carryon,
  title         = {Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents},
  author        = {Lu, Yuchen and McAuley, Julian and Zhang, Lei},
  year          = {2026},

carrycode 和 dsh-carryon 是仅依据论文完成的独立实现，与论文作者及 DeepSeek 均无关联。
dsh-carryon 的代码采用 [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/xuan-tu-ai/dsh-carryon/blob/main/LICENSE)。上文的演示视频和图片属于论文作者，经作者许可在此展示，不在该许可证范围内。
